daemon.description: Run ptunnel-ng as a background daemon process (recommended for servers).

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave blank to log to stderr (useful for systemd/syslog).

ping_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for waiting for ICMP echo replies.

reply_timeout.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for a complete ICMP echo reply sequence.

max_echo_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent ICMP echo requests (higher = more throughput, more packets).

max_icmp_payload.description: Maximum ICMP payload size in bytes. Lower values avoid fragmentation on small-MTU links.

src_interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., 'eth0'). Auto-detected if blank.

listen_addr.description: Local address to bind the TCP proxy to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: Local TCP port where applications connect to use the tunnel.

dst_host.description: Target TCP destination (e.g., web server IP/hostname) behind the remote ptunnel-ng daemon.

dst_icmp.description: IP address of the remote ptunnel-ng ICMP listener (the server you’re tunneling through).

auth_key.description: Shared secret for ICMP authentication (prevents spoofing). Must match on client and server.

port_mappings.description: List of TCP port mappings to forward via a single tunnel (e.g., SSH, HTTP).

local_port.description: Local port to bind for this mapping (e.g., 2222).

remote_host.description: Destination host on the remote network (e.g., internal database).

remote_port.description: Port on the remote host to connect to (e.g., 3306).

allowed_sources.description: List of allowed source IPs/CIDRs for incoming ICMP echo requests (access control).

items.description: Source IP or CIDR subnet (e.g., 10.0.0.0/24) permitted to use the tunnel.

relax_icmp_id.description: Relax strict ICMP identifier matching (use only if NAT/firewall modifies IDs).
